newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand injects 14 bln baht to help currency.
newsitem.headline: Thailand injects 14 bln baht to help currency.

text.p: Thailand's central bank said it injected 14 billion baht into the local money market on Friday to stabilise the national currency following fresh rumours of a possible devaluation.

Governor Rerngchai Marakanond told reporters the central bank made the move earliy on Friday when domestic baht liquidity tightened in the wake of the devaluation rumours and a sharp slide in the Thai stock market.
